title: Apple commits over $30 billion to Broadcom chip deal
title_zh: 苹果承诺向博通芯片交易支付超过 300 亿美元
summary: Investing.com -- Apple announced Tuesday a multiyear agreement with Broadcom valued at more than $30 billion to design and produce custom silicon components and wireless connectivity technologies for Apple products.
summary_zh: Investing.com——苹果周二宣布与博通达成一项价值超过 300 亿美元的多年期协议，为苹果产品设计和生产定制硅元件和无线连接技术。

title: Apple to spend $30 billion in Broadcom chips deal that will see Colorado factory expand
title_zh: 苹果将​​斥资 300 亿美元收购博通芯片交易，科罗拉多州工厂将扩建
summary: Apple plans to spend more than $30 billion as part ‌of a chip-supply agreement reached earlier this ‌week with Broadcom that will also see the chipmaker expand a ​factory in Colorado, the companies said on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 两家公司周三表示，苹果计划斥资超过 300 亿美元，作为本周早些时候与博通达成的芯片供应协议的一部分，该芯片制造商还将扩建科罗拉多州的一家工厂。

title: Apple's expanded Broadcom deal calls for 15 billion U.S.-made chips
title_zh: 苹果扩大博通交易需要 150 亿颗美国制造芯片
summary: Apple said Wednesday it expects to spend over $30 billion in its expanded partnership with Broadcom that will lead to more than 15 billion chips being made in the U.S.
summary_zh: 苹果周三表示，预计将花费超过 300 亿美元扩大与博通的合作伙伴关系，这将导致美国生产超过 150 亿颗芯片。

title: Apple announces chip deal with Broadcom worth more than $30 billion
title_zh: 苹果宣布与博通达成价值超过 300 亿美元的芯片交易
summary: Apple announced a $30 billion deal with Broadcom.
summary_zh: 苹果宣布与博通达成价值 300 亿美元的交易。

title: US stock futures tumble as Trump says Iran deal is 'over'; oil climbs
title_zh: 特朗普称伊朗协议“结束”，美国股指期货暴跌；石油攀升
